SELECT * FROM ( SELECT snsii.PROJECT_NO AS zbCode, snsih.VENDOR_ID AS supId, snsih.VENDOR_NAME AS supName, snsih.CREATION_DATE , snsii.PROJECT_NAME AS projectName, snsii.CATEGORY_NAME AS pl, snsii.IS_BID AS sfBid, snsii.IS_SUCC_BID AS sfBidder, bn.win_amount AS bidderMoney,
soprd.EXT_TENDER_NAME AS tbPerson, soprd.EXT_TENDER_PHONE AS tbTel, soprd.PROJECT_STATUS AS projectStatus FROM meicloud_usrm_cloud_biz_sou.scc_npm_sou_invite_item snsii LEFT JOIN meicloud_usrm_cloud_biz_sou.scc_npm_sou_invite_head snsih ON snsih.INVITE_HEAD_ID = snsii.INVITE_HEAD_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT snsbnd.win_amount, snsbn.ext_project_no FROM meicloud_usrm_cloud_biz_sou.scc_npm_sou_bid_notice_detail snsbnd LEFT JOIN meicloud_usrm_cloud_biz_sou.scc_npm_sou_bid_notice snsbn ON snsbnd.bid_notice_id = snsbn.bid_notice_id WHERE snsbnd.vendor_id = #{pa.supId,jdbcType=BIGINT} ) bn ON bn.ext_project_no = snsii.PROJECT_NO
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sord.EXT_TENDER_NAME , sord.EXT_TENDER_PHONE, spro.EXT_PROJECT_NO, case spro.PROJECT_STATUS when 'ARCHIVE_DONE' THEN '完成' when 'ABANDON' then '取消' ELSE '进行中' end PROJECT_STATUS FROM meicloud_usrm_cloud_biz_sou.scc_sou_order sord JOIN meicloud_usrm_cloud_biz_sou.scc_sou_project spro ON spro.PROJECT_ID = sord.PROJECT_ID WHERE sord.VENDOR_ID = #{pa.supId,jdbcType=BIGINT} ) soprd ON soprd.EXT_PROJECT_NO = snsii.PROJECT_NO ) t
AND t.supId = #{pa.supId,jdbcType=BIGINT}
AND t.projectName LIKE CONCAT('%', #{pa.projectName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%')
AND t.pl LIKE CONCAT('%', #{pa.pl,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%')
AND t.zbCode LIKE CONCAT('%', #{pa.projectCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%')
ORDER BY t.CREATION_DATE DESC

SELECT snpsh.BID_CODE AS zbCode, snpsh.SCORE AS htGetScore, snpsh.LEVEL_NAME AS htResult, snpsh.SUPPLIER_REMARK AS htDealResult, snpsh.PROJECT_STATUS as htStatus FROM meicloud_usrm_cloud_biz_performance.scc_npm_project_score_header snpsh WHERE snpsh.PERFORMANCE_TYPE = 'PROJECT' AND snpsh.COMPANY_ID = #{supId,jdbcType=BIGINT}
SELECT ch.CONTRACT_HEAD_ID FROM meicloud_usrm_cloud_biz_contract.scc_contract_head ch WHERE ch.vendor_id = #{supId,jdbcType=BIGINT} AND ch.SOURCE_NUMBER = #{projectNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT snsih.VENDOR_ID FROM meicloud_usrm_cloud_biz_sou.scc_npm_sou_invite_item snsii LEFT JOIN meicloud_usrm_cloud_biz_sou.scc_npm_sou_invite_head snsih ON snsih.INVITE_HEAD_ID = snsii.INVITE_HEAD_ID
AND snsii.PROJECT_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{pa.projectName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%')
AND snsii.PROJECT_NO LIKE CONCAT('%', #{pa.projectCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%')
AND snsii.CATEGORY_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{pa.pl,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%')
